what: Resume classification is ordered after the unconditional entry `_write_ship_state(ctx, phase="checks")`, which writes default-zero counters
scenario_or_breakage: The plan places `_resume_plan` after repo/tmpdir setup but does not require relocating it before the existing checks-phase write. A literal insert leaves `ITERATION`/`REBASE_COUNT`/`FIX_ATTEMPTS`/`TRANSIENT_RETRIES` and `PHASE=checks` clobbered before `open-pr`/`merged`/`done` branches run, reproducing the counter-reset bug on the first resume handback
suggested_fix: Branch on `_resume_plan` immediately after tmpdir validation and before any `_write_ship_state`; only the `fresh` path may emit `phase="checks"`
